patches_added.name: ADB server log
patches_added.description: Writes the native ADB server's own log to /data/local/tmp/tvqa-server.log and lets its debug messages through. The server is started again every few seconds and nothing of what it says is reachable otherwise: its logger is built at a level that drops every message, and its output is sent to /dev/null. Use this to find out why it ends, not as a fix.

In a guest, office or co-working network the devices are often kept apart, and then nothing is found. Needs Game Review on your computer, from this bundle.

patches_added.name: Anonymous profile viewing
patches_added.description: Adds an option (off by default, experimental) to visit profiles without sending the profile view event, while you keep seeing who viewed your own profile.

patches_added.name: Keep feed on reopen
patches_added.description: Keeps your place in the feed when you come back to LinkedIn, instead of reloading it. Pull down or tap the "New posts" button to load new posts.

patches_added.name: Post menu items
patches_added.description: Adds Copy text, Download photos and videos, and Save document as PDF to the ⋯ menu of posts.

patches_added.name: Swipe between feeds
patches_added.description: Swipe left and right on the home feed to switch between For you and Network, like on X.

patches_added.name: Tap to hide in viewers
patches_added.description: Tap a video or document in full screen to hide the caption and buttons, like photos.

patches_modified.name: Block tracking
patches_modified.description: Adds an option (off by default) to stop sending most LinkedIn analytics events.

patches_modified.name: Copy text
patches_modified.description: Long press a post, comment or any other text to select and copy it in place, like on Reddit.

patches_modified.name: Disable double-tap like
patches_modified.description: Stops double tapping a post or photo from liking it.

patches_modified.name: Download media
patches_modified.description: Adds a download button to the full screen photo, video and document viewer. Documents (PDFs and carousels) are saved as one PDF.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a download button to the full screen photo and video viewer.

patches_modified.name: Feed filters
patches_modified.description: Adds optional filters (off by default, turned on in Loki Patches): focus mode, celebrations, job cards, reposts, posts from others' activity, "Recommended for you", video posts, games, the "New posts" pill and "See translation".

patches_modified.name: GmsCore support
patches_modified.description: Makes "Continue with Google" work in patched LinkedIn by signing in through microG RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services. Needs microG RE installed and signed in to a Google account.

patches_modified.name: Hide Premium upsells
patches_modified.description: Removes Premium and AI upsell cards and banners, including on profiles and the Me panel.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Removes promoted (sponsored) posts from the feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide promoted jobs
patches_modified.description: Removes promoted job listings from the Jobs tab and job search.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested posts
patches_modified.description: Removes "Suggested" posts from outside your network from the feed.

patches_modified.name: Material You
patches_modified.description: Uses your wallpaper's colors (Android 12+): the accent color instead of LinkedIn blue and the green of selected filters, and Material 3 surface colors for backgrounds, cards, bars and borders. Some screens drawn by LinkedIn's servers may keep their own colors.

patches_modified.name: Messaging
patches_modified.description: Hides sponsored messages, and adds an optional ghost mode that does not send typing indicators or read status.

patches_modified.name: Open links directly
patches_modified.description: Opens external links without LinkedIn's safety/go warning page.

patches_modified.name: Remove gaps and dividers
patches_modified.description: Removes the gray gaps between posts and the dividers between list items, so the feed and lists are one flat surface.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize share links
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking parameters from LinkedIn links when they are copied or shared.

patches_added.name: Hide the reply box on stories
patches_added.description: Takes the Send message box off the bottom of other people's stories. The like and share buttons next to it stay where they are. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_added.name: Keep playing in the background
patches_added.description: A video or reel playing with sound keeps going when you leave Instagram or turn the screen off, with a notification to pause or stop it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Accent color
patches_modified.description: Swaps Instagram's blue on Follow buttons, links and other highlights for purple, pink, red, orange, green, teal or your wallpaper's colors (Material You, on Android 12 and newer). Restart Instagram to see a change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_modified.name: Allow screenshots
patches_modified.description: Lets you take screenshots and record your screen where Instagram normally blocks it, such as disappearing photos and videos in chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Ambient light
patches_modified.description: Puts a soft glow in a post's own colors around its photo or video in Home and Following, and in the bands around a reel that doesn't fill the screen. The glow follows a video as it plays, and you pick how far it spreads and how fast it changes. A second switch fills the bands above and below a story that doesn't fill the screen. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Feed and Stories.

patches_modified.name: App-only proxy
patches_modified.description: Sends Instagram through an HTTP proxy you set, without changing the proxy for other apps or the phone. You need to set a server too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches_modified.name: Ask before a call
patches_modified.description: Asks you to confirm before a call starts from a chat, so a stray tap on the call button doesn't ring anyone, and can take the call buttons off the top of a chat. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Ask before a like
patches_modified.description: Asks you to confirm before the Like button under a post likes or unlikes it, so a stray tap doesn't do it for you. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Ask before a refresh
patches_modified.description: Asks you to confirm before pulling down refreshes Home, Reels or another list, so an accidental pull doesn't replace what you were reading. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Back leaves Home
patches_modified.description: Makes Back on Home leave Instagram at once, instead of first scrolling the feed to the top and reloading it or saying "Tap again to exit". Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Blur the bars around Reels
patches_modified.description: Shows a blurred copy of a reel above and below it, or beside it, where Instagram would leave black bars. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Carousel arrows
patches_modified.description: Puts a back and a next arrow on a post's carousel in Home and Following, so a tap moves to the next photo or video without a swipe, and can move its page dots onto a round pill over the photo. The pill can be solid, see-through or frosted glass. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Change the like animation
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick the animation that plays when you double tap a post to like it. The choices are animations Instagram made for its Rings creators. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Change version code
patches_modified.description: Stops Google Play from offering Meta's updates over your patched Instagram. Going back to the normal Instagram later means uninstalling first, which deletes its data. Later HushGram builds need this patch too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Chat history tools
patches_modified.description: Tap the clock button at the top of a chat, or long press its name, to jump to its first message or to a date, or to save the chat as a text file. The chat loads its older messages on its own, with a count and a Cancel button. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Chat plus menu
patches_modified.description: Lets you take Saved, AI images and Draw off the plus menu in a chat's message bar, and move the gallery and microphone buttons into that menu. Starts with every switch off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels
patches_modified.description: Hides extra buttons and prompts on reels, such as Follow, Edits, templates, Meta AI, Ray-Ban Meta glasses, friends' activity, the Add a comment bar, the reply bar on reels from chats, the Save button, the Create and Your algorithm buttons, the Friends tab and the Reels tab's top bar. Each one has its own switch, and Burn-in guard can dim a reel's buttons, and a story's, while you aren't touching the screen. Keep clear mode on carries Instagram's clear mode to the next reels, and can start every reel in it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Clear the media cache
patches_modified.description: Frees storage by deleting Instagram's saved copies of photos and videos once they pass 500 MB. Your sign-in, drafts and settings stay. A row clears them right away. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Storage.

patches_modified.name: Control taps and volume on Reels
patches_modified.description: Lets you choose what a single tap on a reel does: Instagram's default, pause, or mute. Can also keep a reel muted when you press volume up. Both start at Instagram's behavior. Choose them in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Copy comment
patches_modified.description: Adds Copy and Copy username to the menu you get on a comment, so you can copy its text or the commenter's username. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Data saver
patches_modified.description: Saves mobile data by loading smaller photos and starting videos at the lowest quality. It uses Full resolution photos and Default playback quality, so it turns both on. It starts with mobile data only. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Default playback quality
patches_modified.description: Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose, instead of the one Instagram picks as it plays. Nothing changes until you pick a quality. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Don't report Blend visits
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from telling a chat that you opened its Blend. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Don't report screenshots
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from telling people when you take a screenshot of their disappearing photo or video. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Don't save recent searches
patches_modified.description: Keeps the accounts and tags you open from search out of your Recent list. Searches already in Recent stay until you clear them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Explore.

patches_modified.name: Don't send reel watch history
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from learning which reels you watched and how far you got. Reels you've already watched may come back. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Download any reel
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to the menu of every reel and saves it without Instagram's watermark. You choose the quality, and best is the default. A separate Download cover switch also saves the reel's cover picture, the largest one the post carries, and Download audio saves just its sound. Download as video on a carousel with music saves every page, in order. A separate switch under Downloads puts a download icon under Save beside each reel, and others add a Lens icon for copying a reel's text, a speed icon and a Full screen icon. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Download any story
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to the menu of anyone's story. Videos save at the quality you choose and photos at their largest size, and Download as photo saves a still from a video story. A Download button at the top of a story is a separate switch, off to start, and so is a Copy text button that opens Google Lens on the story. Turn them on or off in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Download any video
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to video posts in your feed, saving the video without Instagram's watermark. Other switches add Download for photos, Download cover, a Details row with the post's time and poster, a download icon beside Save under each post, and Hold to download, which saves a post or reel you hold two fingers on. Download all waits its turn, with up to ten posts queued, so two posts' pages never mix in your gallery. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Download voice messages
patches_modified.description: Adds Save to the menu you get when you hold a voice message in a chat. It saves the recording as an audio file. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Emoji style
patches_modified.description: Shows every emoji in Google's style instead of your phone's own, or in a free emoji pack (Twemoji, OpenMoji, Blobmoji) or a color emoji font file you pick. The full change shows after you restart Instagram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_modified.name: Explore without personalization
patches_modified.description: Opens Explore on the grid that isn't personalized every time and keeps it from switching back after ten minutes. Instagram only promises that grid in the EU. A second switch hides the EU menu button for it. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Explore.

patches_modified.name: Find the reel you came from
patches_modified.description: Open a creator's profile from a reel, then their Reels tab, and it scrolls to that reel and outlines it for a moment. A photo reel is found in their posts. Stop looking ends the search, and Wait for a tap to find it holds it until you tap Find the reel. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Font
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick the font Instagram's text uses: Instagram's own, your phone's, or a .ttf or .otf file. Restart Instagram to see a change. Starts on Instagram's font. Pick one in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_modified.name: Full resolution photos
patches_modified.description: Loads photos in the largest size Instagram sends instead of one picked for your screen. A second switch asks for a larger size on screens under 1440 pixels wide, and a third gets reel covers and grid pictures at full size. Uses more data. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Full screen Reels and Home
patches_modified.description: Hides the status bar and the navigation bar while Reels shows, and optionally while Home or your messages do. Swipe in from the edge to bring them back for a moment. Back and the keyboard work as usual. It can also show stories over the whole screen on tall phones. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels (Full screen Reels), Feed (Full screen Home), Messages (Full screen Messages) and Stories (Stories fill the screen).

patches_modified.name: Glass in chats
patches_modified.description: Gives a chat's top bar frosted glass that blurs the messages under it (Android 12 and newer) and puts the back, call and video buttons on round glass circles. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Glass tab bar
patches_modified.description: Draws the tab bar as a floating, rounded pill of frosted glass that blurs what's behind it (Android 12 and newer), with a highlight on the tab you're on. Content can optionally run down behind it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Tab bar, then restart Instagram.

patches_modified.name: Group Instagram's notifications
patches_modified.description: Puts Instagram's notifications in one group, or in a group for each type, so they don't fill your notification shade. Tapping one still opens it. You can also mute the types you pick, like promo pushes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Hide AI-labeled reels
patches_modified.description: Leaves out reels that carry Instagram's own AI label. A reel without that label stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Hide Follow on feed posts
patches_modified.description: Takes the Follow and Subscribe buttons off the top of posts in your feed. The name, time and menu stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide Follow on stories
patches_modified.description: Takes the Follow button off the top of stories from accounts you don't follow. The name, time and menu stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Hide Instants
patches_modified.description: Takes the stack of Instants out of your messages. Instants is Instagram's no-edit camera for sharing quick photos with friends. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta AI
patches_modified.description: Removes Meta AI from Instagram's search bars, messages, home top bar, reels menus, share sheet and feed. Each part has its own switch. The search one and the Meta AI posts one start on, the rest start off. Change them in HushGram settings > Meta AI.

patches_modified.name: Hide Notes on profile pictures
patches_modified.description: Takes the Notes bubble off profile pictures, yours included. Notes in Messages stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_modified.name: Hide Reels in the feed
patches_modified.description: Removes the rows of suggested reels from your home feed. A reel posted by someone you follow stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Hide activity bubbles
patches_modified.description: Takes the little round pictures off posts and reels that show a friend liked, commented on or reshared them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Hides sponsored posts, reels, stories and the ad in comments, and leaves no gap where an ad would have been. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide captions
patches_modified.description: Takes the caption off posts in your feed and off reels. The post stays, and the comments sheet still shows it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide comments
patches_modified.description: Takes the Comment button and the comment count off posts in your feed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide group buttons on the share sheet
patches_modified.description: Takes the New group button and the button that sends to several people as a group off the share sheet, and lets you pick which of the round buttons under the people it shows. You can still start a group from your messages. Both start off. Find them in HushGram settings > Sharing.

patches_modified.name: Hide highlights
patches_modified.description: Takes the row of story highlights off profiles, yours and other people's. Bios, counts and posts stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_modified.name: Hide paid partnership Reels
patches_modified.description: Leaves out reels with a Paid partnership label, and reels Instagram marks as boosted. Ads have their own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Hide profile tabs
patches_modified.description: Lets you take the Reels, Reposts and Tagged tabs off profiles, yours and other people's, and keep the grid. Starts with every tab showing. Pick which to hide in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_modified.name: Hide reels by caption words
patches_modified.description: Leaves out reels whose caption holds a word or phrase from your list, or is in a language you don't keep, and Home's posts too with Also on Home. Starts off. Turn it on and type the words or languages in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Leaves out reels whose caption holds a word or phrase from your list, and Home's posts too with Also on Home. Starts off. Turn it on and type the words in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Hide reels with few views
patches_modified.description: Leaves out reels in the Reels tab with fewer views or likes than numbers you pick. Accounts you follow stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Hide rows in Instagram's settings
patches_modified.description: Lets you take the rows you don't use off Instagram's own Settings and activity screen. Open that screen once, then untick rows in HushGram settings > Layout > Rows in Instagram's settings. Every row shows to start.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested accounts in DMs
patches_modified.description: Takes the Accounts to follow section off the bottom of your messages. Your chats and follow requests stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested accounts in Reels
patches_modified.description: Leaves out the cards of accounts to follow that Instagram puts between reels. Every reel still plays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested people on profiles
patches_modified.description: Takes Suggested for you and the Discover people button off profiles. Bios, counts and posts stay. More switches take Suggested for you off the follow lists, their Suggested tab and the Follow requests screen, the Complete your profile cards off your own profile, and People you don't follow back, suggested threads and people, and the Featured section off your notifications. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested posts
patches_modified.description: Removes posts from accounts you don't follow, suggested accounts, surveys and shopping rows from Home. It also takes shop tiles out of Explore and the shopping bag off posts with tagged products. Posts from accounts you follow stay. Extra switches can also hide the 'Are you interested in this post?' question on Home and Reels, the caught up card, all videos, photos, carousels, posts you've liked or posts from accounts you pick. A post's menu has Hide posts from this account to add one to that list, and those posts leave Home on the next refresh. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested stories
patches_modified.description: Removes stories from accounts you don't follow from the row at the top of Home. More switches hide rewinds and memories, keep only verified or unverified accounts, or hide the whole row. Starts on. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Hide that you're typing
patches_modified.description: Stops the people you're chatting with from seeing when you're typing. You still see when they type. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Explore grid
patches_modified.description: Empties the grid of posts and reels on the Search tab. Search, recent searches and results stay. A second switch hides the suggested accounts that show when you tap the search bar. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Explore.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Reels tab
patches_modified.description: Takes the Reels tab off the tab bar. Reels in your feed and reels people send you still open. A second switch, Show the Reels tab, puts it back after Home when Instagram built your bar without one, and Hide wins if both are on. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels. Under Tab bar, switches do the same for Home, Search, Create, Messages and Profile, two put Messages or Activity on the bar when Instagram left them off, switches take the Create and notifications buttons off Home's header, others add a Search, Messages, Ghost mode or menu button to it or put Instagram's logo in its middle, two center the name at the top of profiles and the title on other screens, a list puts the tabs in your order, and another picks the tab Instagram opens on.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Repost button
patches_modified.description: Takes the Repost button and its count off posts and reels, so nothing gets reposted by mistake. Share still works. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Sharing.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Share button
patches_modified.description: Takes the Share button and its count off posts in your feed and off reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Sharing.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Threads button
patches_modified.description: Takes the Threads button off the top of profiles, with switches for the Create button and Share profile on your own, and Subscribe and the arrow after the buttons on creators' profiles. The menu and the other buttons stay. Each starts off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_modified.name: Hide the audio icon on posts
patches_modified.description: Takes the speaker icon off videos in your feed. Tapping the video still turns the sound on or off. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide the comment emoji row
patches_modified.description: Takes the row of quick emoji off above the comment box. The box itself stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide the home feed
patches_modified.description: Empties your home feed on purpose, so Home shows only the stories row. Profiles, Explore and Reels still show posts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide the notes row
patches_modified.description: Takes the row of notes, and the Map bubble in it, off the top of your messages. Your chats stay. A second switch takes only the Map bubble. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Hide the reply box on stories
patches_modified.description: Takes the Send message box off the bottom of other people's stories. The like and share buttons next to it stay where they are. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Hide the search bar in Messages
patches_modified.description: Takes the search bar and its Filter button off the top of your messages, the Meta AI bar too. Your chats and notes stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Hide your active status
patches_modified.description: Stops people from seeing Active now for you while you use Instagram. You still see when they're active. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Home header text
patches_modified.description: Puts words of your own, or a picture, at the top of Home in place of Instagram's logo. Nothing changes until you set one in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_modified.name: HushGram launch screen
patches_modified.description: Shows HushGram's logo instead of Instagram's on the screen you see while Instagram starts, on Android 13 and newer. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_modified.name: HushGram settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushGram settings page to Instagram. Open it by long-pressing the Instagram logo at the top of your feed or Instagram's icon, or from the top of Settings and activity. Turn features on or off there, pause HushGram and save diagnostics. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Install next to Instagram
patches_modified.description: Installs this build as a second Instagram beside your normal one, with its own data and sign-in. Pick its package name and app name in the patch's options, and whether its icon gets a HushGram badge. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Keep Home's top bar
patches_modified.description: Keeps the Instagram logo and the buttons beside it at the top of Home while you scroll. A second switch shows your feed blurred under them. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Keep Reels auto scroll on
patches_modified.description: Keeps Instagram's auto scroll in Reels turned on after you leave Reels or restart Instagram, until you turn it off yourself. It can also move on to the next reel when one ends on accounts where Instagram doesn't offer auto scroll. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Keep a seek bar on Reels
patches_modified.description: Keeps a seek bar under every reel, short ones too, with the time played and the reel's length above it, like 0:10 / 0:55. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Keep in chat
patches_modified.description: Keeps view once and replayable photos and videos in your chats after you open them, so they don't disappear. A photo or video you send stays Instagram's own sent bubble. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Keep stories playing while zooming
patches_modified.description: Keeps a story playing while you pinch to zoom it, instead of pausing it. A story you hold still first stays paused. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Keep the Reels top bar
patches_modified.description: Keeps the Reels title, the Friends tab and the buttons beside them at the top while you swipe through reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Keep the reel speed
patches_modified.description: Keeps the 2x speed on for the next reels after you lock a reel at 2x (hold its edge, then slide down), until you slide the lock off. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Keep your place in Home
patches_modified.description: Coming back to Instagram leaves Home on the post you were on, however long you were away, instead of reloading it and jumping to the top. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Lock your messages
patches_modified.description: Covers your inbox and chats, all of Instagram, or just the single chats you pick under Locked chats, until your fingerprint, face or screen lock says it's you. Message notifications only say that a message came. Chats you pick under Hidden chats leave your inbox and their notifications don't post. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Long press to zoom
patches_modified.description: Press and hold a photo in a feed to see it twice as big around your finger, and let go to close it. Pinch to zoom still works. Keep the zoom open leaves it up after you let go, to drag and pinch from 1x to 4x until a tap or Back closes it. While its switch is on, it takes the place of Instagram's own long press on a photo. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Loop a story
patches_modified.description: Plays a story again from the start when it ends, instead of moving on to the next one. Tap or swipe to move on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Mark one-time photos and videos
patches_modified.description: Puts a border and Instagram's own view once icon on a one-time photo or video in a chat, so you can tell it before you open it. Only how the chat looks changes. Nothing is saved, replayed, marked seen or sent. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Message box buttons
patches_modified.description: Lets you take the gallery, sticker and voice message buttons off the message box of a chat, and keep the text box and Send. Starts with every button showing. Pick which to hide in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Open comments without the keyboard
patches_modified.description: Comments open with the keyboard down. A tap in the comment box, or on Reply, still brings it up. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Open links in external browser
patches_modified.description: Opens web links you tap in your usual browser instead of Instagram's built-in one, without Instagram's click tracker. Instagram pages and ads still open in the app. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches_modified.name: Phone layout on big screens
patches_modified.description: On a foldable or tablet, Instagram keeps its phone layout across the whole screen, with the tab bar at the bottom instead of down the side. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_modified.name: Pick the app icon
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick the icon Instagram shows on your home screen: Instagram's own, HushGram's, Instagram's glyph on black, on plum, or in black on white, a hand-drawn Instagram glyph on white, Instagram's gradient glyph on dark, the old retro camera icon, or Instagram's glyph in pink on pale pink. The new icon shows once you leave Instagram, and you may need to add it to your home screen again from the app drawer. Starts on Instagram's own. Pick one in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_modified.name: Pinch to zoom on Reels
patches_modified.description: Lets you zoom into a playing reel with two fingers, the way a photo zooms. Lift your fingers and it goes back. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Preview chats
patches_modified.description: Long press a chat in your messages and tap Preview to read its newest messages without opening it, so nobody sees Seen. You can reply from there too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Profile posts as a list
patches_modified.description: Opening someone's profile takes you on to their posts as a scrolling list of full posts. Back shows the grid. Your own profile keeps its grid. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_modified.name: Pure black dark mode
patches_modified.description: Makes Instagram's dark mode pure black instead of dark gray, on the menus that slide up from the bottom too. It looks deeper and can save battery on an OLED screen. Buttons keep their grays so they stay easy to see. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Read messages without the seen receipt
patches_modified.description: Opening a chat no longer tells people you've seen their messages. You still see when they've seen yours. Mark as read, or the check mark at the top of a chat, still tells them. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Remove build expired popup
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from locking you out with a screen that says this version is too old. A patched build can't update itself, so it would stop working after a few weeks. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Version warnings.

patches_modified.name: Remove the advertising ID
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from reading your phone's advertising ID, which ad companies use to follow you between apps. Instagram gets a string of zeros instead. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Remove the empty space at the bottom
patches_modified.description: Takes away the empty gap Instagram leaves under its tab bar for a navigation bar that isn't there. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_modified.name: Restore trust on re-signed builds
patches_modified.description: Lets Instagram's own checks of who signed the app pass on a patched build, so the parts that need them keep working. Threads, Facebook and Messenger patched with the same key work too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Resume long videos
patches_modified.description: A video or reel longer than two minutes picks up where you left off the next time you play it on the same account. Live videos and ads start as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Rounded post corners
patches_modified.description: Rounds the corners of a post's photo, video and carousel pages in Home and Following, and of reels and stories if you like, at a small or large size. Profiles and Explore stay as Instagram draws them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking tags from the links you copy or share, and opens bio links without Instagram's click tracker. The link still opens the same post, reel, story or profile. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches_modified.name: Save comment photo
patches_modified.description: Adds Save to the menu on a comment that has its own photo or GIF, saving the largest size Instagram sent. A GIF is saved as a .gif in Pictures/Instagram, taken from Instagram's own copy, not Giphy. If Instagram lists only an animated WebP or an MP4 for it, you get that file instead, and an MP4 goes in Movies/Instagram like a video. It can also add a GIF reply to a comment with a GIF, sending that same GIF back as your reply. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Save profile picture
patches_modified.description: Adds Save profile picture, View profile picture, Copy username and Copy bio to the menu on someone's profile. View opens the picture full screen and lets you zoom. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Saved on your profile
patches_modified.description: Adds a bookmark to the tabs on your own profile, beside posts, reels and tagged, that opens Saved. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles, then restart Instagram.

patches_modified.name: See who a story mentions
patches_modified.description: Adds a small label in a story's header showing how many accounts it mentions. Tap it for a list and tap an account to open their profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Seek bar on feed videos
patches_modified.description: Shows a bar along the bottom of the video playing in your feed that you can drag to jump to any point in it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed. Another switch there adds a small button on the video that shows or hides the bar, and a choice under it makes the bar see-through or puts it on frosted glass.

patches_modified.name: Seek bar on stories
patches_modified.description: Shows a bar near the bottom of a video story that you can drag to jump to any point in the video. Photos don't get one. A choice under it makes the bar see-through or puts it on frosted glass. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Show a post's exact time
patches_modified.description: Shows the date and time a post went up, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, instead of how long ago. It does the same for comments. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Show a reel's exact time
patches_modified.description: Adds the date and time a reel was posted under the author's name, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, with the seconds or how long ago (1d 2h 5m ago) if you want them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Show a story's exact time
patches_modified.description: Shows the date and time a story was posted, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, instead of how long ago. A choice under the switch can show the time left instead. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Show all recent searches
patches_modified.description: Lists every recent search under the search bar instead of the first few. See all and the x on each row work as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Explore.

patches_modified.name: Show hidden like counts
patches_modified.description: Shows how many likes a post or reel has when its owner hid the count, as long as Instagram's server still sends the number. If it doesn't, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Show if a profile follows you
patches_modified.description: Adds Follows you or Doesn't follow you beside the name on someone's profile. Other switches add a chip and mark accounts on your Following list that don't follow you back, and Recent unfollowers shows who left your Followers list, with a Follower history of who left, came back or is new. The chip is blue for Follows you, green for Following each other and red for Doesn't follow you, and it can go small under the profile picture. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_modified.name: Show when someone was last active
patches_modified.description: Shows the exact time someone was last on, like Active at 3:42 PM, in your messages and in a chat, instead of Active 3h ago. Active now stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Skip the ad data reminder
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram's reminder to review whether it can process your data for ads from opening by itself. Your ad choice doesn't change and nothing is answered for you. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches_modified.name: Skip the collections tray
patches_modified.description: Saving a post or reel shows Instagram's Saved message instead of the tray that asks you to start a collection. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Skip the contacts and location popups
patches_modified.description: Stops the screens asking you to sync your contacts and turn on location services from opening each time Instagram starts. Nothing else is skipped. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches_modified.name: Smooth story opening
patches_modified.description: Opens a story from the stories row with a slower, gentler zoom instead of Instagram's quick spring. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Speed button on stories
patches_modified.description: Puts a speed button at the top of a video story. Tap it to play the story at 1.5x or 2x, and later video stories keep that speed. Photos and ads play as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Spoof location
patches_modified.description: Tells Instagram your phone is at a place you pick, for the location sticker, nearby places and maps. Photos keep their own places. You need to pick a place too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches_modified.name: Start Home on Following
patches_modified.description: Opens Home on posts from accounts you follow instead of For you. A second switch removes For you from Home, and a third keeps Instagram's logo at the top of Home in place of the feed's name. A fourth, Fall back to Following, opens Home on Following for an account whose For you brings only suggested posts, unless you picked a feed. A fifth, Mix in Following, shows a page of posts from accounts you follow after each page of For you. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Start feed videos with sound
patches_modified.description: Starts the first video on Home with its sound on, the same as tapping the video's speaker. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Start on x86 devices
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from crashing or freezing on x86 devices that run its code through a translator, such as some Chromebooks and emulators. Phones and tablets with arm chips run it as before. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Start reels with sound
patches_modified.description: A reel you open from a post on Home plays with sound, and Home is muted again when you go back. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. A separate switch, Start reels muted, starts every reel silent instead. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Start stories with sound
patches_modified.description: Opens stories with their sound on, the same as tapping Instagram's speaker. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Stop Reels scrolling
patches_modified.description: Stops a swipe in Reels from moving to the next reel, so you stay on the one you opened. A second switch stops swiping after as many reels as you pick, for as long as you pick, and Take a scroll break covers Home, Reels and Explore for 5 minutes after the time you pick. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Stop Story auto-advance
patches_modified.description: Keeps each story on screen until you tap or swipe. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Stop background wake-ups
patches_modified.description: Stops two alarms that wake your phone while Instagram is in the background. One goes off every minute or two only to note that Instagram is still running, and the other wakes it five minutes later to upload usage events. Messages and notifications still arrive. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Battery.

patches_modified.name: Stop swipe to create
patches_modified.description: Stops a sideways swipe on Home from opening the camera. The + button still opens it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Stop swipe up to reply
patches_modified.description: Stops a swipe up on someone's story from opening the reply box and its reactions. Tapping Send message still replies. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Stop swiping between tabs
patches_modified.description: Stops a sideways swipe from moving between Home, Reels and the other main tabs. Tapping the tab bar still works. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Stop videos looping
patches_modified.description: Feed videos and reels stop at their last frame instead of playing again. Reels still loop while auto scroll is on, so it can move on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Stories priority
patches_modified.description: Puts the accounts on your list first in the stories row at the top of Home while they have a story you haven't watched. Starts off. Turn it on and type the accounts in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Story ring size
patches_modified.description: Draws the rings in the stories row at the top of Home smaller, so more fit on screen, or larger, and the ring of a story you haven't watched in a color you pick. Nothing changes until you pick a size or a color. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Story text fonts
patches_modified.description: Adds fonts you pick from your phone (.ttf or .otf files) to the story text editor alongside Instagram's own fonts, and can draw the emoji in story text from an emoji font file you pick. Starts off. Set both up in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Swipe left to open the profile
patches_modified.description: Makes a left swipe on a reel open the profile of the person who posted it, like Instagram used to. Tap Friends at the top to reach your friends' reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Swipe through a chat's reels
patches_modified.description: Swiping up on a reel you opened from a chat goes through the other reels shared in that chat before any suggested reels, can stop after them and can leave out the ones you sent. All start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Tab bar layout
patches_modified.description: Lets you keep the newer tab bar, where you swipe between every tab, or the classic one, instead of the one Instagram picks for your account. Starts on Instagram's choice. Pick one in HushGram settings > Tab bar.

patches_modified.name: Tap a feed video to pause it
patches_modified.description: A tap on the video playing in a feed pauses it in place instead of opening it in Reels, and another tap plays it again. Ads keep Instagram's own tap. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Tap to play
patches_modified.description: Makes videos, reels and stories wait for your tap instead of starting by themselves, like Instagram does when it saves mobile data. A choice under the switch can leave Reels out or hold only Reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Thicker story progress bar
patches_modified.description: Draws the progress bar along the top of a story twice or three times as thick. Its segments and timing stay as they were. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Turn off HDR brightness boosts
patches_modified.description: Stops HDR photos and reels from making the screen brighter than everything else. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Turn off double tap to like
patches_modified.description: Stops a double tap on a post or reel from liking it, and the heart doesn't show. The Like button still works. Separate switches cover posts, reels, comments and chat messages. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Upload stories at full quality
patches_modified.description: Sends the video stories you post at 1080p and a higher bitrate, as Instagram does with its own Upload at highest quality setting on. Two choices under it can cover posts and reels too and ask for a bitrate up to 50 Mbps. Instagram still shrinks story videos to 720p on its servers, so viewers see a small difference. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Use the highest refresh rate
patches_modified.description: Asks Android to run Instagram at your screen's fastest refresh rate, at the same resolution, so scrolling looks smoother on a 90 or 120 Hz phone. Some phones keep their own limit for apps. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_modified.name: View DM photos and videos anonymously
patches_modified.description: Holds back the Opened notice for view once photos and videos in messages, so the sender doesn't see you opened them. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches_modified.name: View live anonymously
patches_modified.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of the lives you watch, so the host isn't told you're there. Your own lives still count their viewers. An optional eye button at the top of a live puts you on that one's list. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: View stories anonymously
patches_modified.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of the stories you watch. Replying or reacting still shows you. An optional Mark as seen button lets you choose. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_added.name: Hide the reply box on stories
patches_added.description: Takes the Send message box off the bottom of other people's stories. The like and share buttons next to it stay where they are. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_added.name: Keep playing in the background
patches_added.description: A video or reel playing with sound keeps going when you leave Instagram or turn the screen off, with a notification to pause or stop it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Accent color
patches_modified.description: Swaps Instagram's blue on Follow buttons, links and other highlights for purple, pink, red, orange, green, teal or your wallpaper's colors (Material You, on Android 12 and newer). Restart Instagram to see a change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_modified.name: Allow screenshots
patches_modified.description: Lets you take screenshots and record your screen where Instagram normally blocks it, such as disappearing photos and videos in chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Ambient light
patches_modified.description: Puts a soft glow in a post's own colors around its photo or video in Home and Following, and in the bands around a reel that doesn't fill the screen. The glow follows a video as it plays, and you pick how far it spreads and how fast it changes. A second switch fills the bands above and below a story that doesn't fill the screen. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Feed and Stories.

patches_modified.name: App-only proxy
patches_modified.description: Sends Instagram through an HTTP proxy you set, without changing the proxy for other apps or the phone. You need to set a server too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches_modified.name: Ask before a call
patches_modified.description: Asks you to confirm before a call starts from a chat, so a stray tap on the call button doesn't ring anyone, and can take the call buttons off the top of a chat. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Ask before a like
patches_modified.description: Asks you to confirm before the Like button under a post likes or unlikes it, so a stray tap doesn't do it for you. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Ask before a refresh
patches_modified.description: Asks you to confirm before pulling down refreshes Home, Reels or another list, so an accidental pull doesn't replace what you were reading. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Back leaves Home
patches_modified.description: Makes Back on Home leave Instagram at once, instead of first scrolling the feed to the top and reloading it or saying "Tap again to exit". Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Blur the bars around Reels
patches_modified.description: Shows a blurred copy of a reel above and below it, or beside it, where Instagram would leave black bars. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Carousel arrows
patches_modified.description: Puts a back and a next arrow on a post's carousel in Home and Following, so a tap moves to the next photo or video without a swipe, and can move its page dots onto a round pill over the photo. The pill can be solid, see-through or frosted glass. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Change the like animation
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick the animation that plays when you double tap a post to like it. The choices are animations Instagram made for its Rings creators. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Change version code
patches_modified.description: Stops Google Play from offering Meta's updates over your patched Instagram. Going back to the normal Instagram later means uninstalling first, which deletes its data. Later HushGram builds need this patch too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Chat history tools
patches_modified.description: Tap the clock button at the top of a chat, or long press its name, to jump to its first message or to a date, or to save the chat as a text file. The chat loads its older messages on its own, with a count and a Cancel button. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Chat plus menu
patches_modified.description: Lets you take Saved, AI images and Draw off the plus menu in a chat's message bar, and move the gallery and microphone buttons into that menu. Starts with every switch off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels
patches_modified.description: Hides extra buttons and prompts on reels, such as Follow, Edits, templates, Meta AI, Ray-Ban Meta glasses, friends' activity, the Add a comment bar, the reply bar on reels from chats, the Save button, the Create and Your algorithm buttons, the Friends tab and the Reels tab's top bar. Each one has its own switch, and Burn-in guard can dim a reel's buttons, and a story's, while you aren't touching the screen. Keep clear mode on carries Instagram's clear mode to the next reels, and can start every reel in it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Clear the media cache
patches_modified.description: Frees storage by deleting Instagram's saved copies of photos and videos once they pass 500 MB. Your sign-in, drafts and settings stay. A row clears them right away. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Storage.

patches_modified.name: Control taps and volume on Reels
patches_modified.description: Lets you choose what a single tap on a reel does: Instagram's default, pause, or mute. Can also keep a reel muted when you press volume up. Both start at Instagram's behavior. Choose them in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Copy comment
patches_modified.description: Adds Copy and Copy username to the menu you get on a comment, so you can copy its text or the commenter's username. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Data saver
patches_modified.description: Saves mobile data by loading smaller photos and starting videos at the lowest quality. It uses Full resolution photos and Default playback quality, so it turns both on. It starts with mobile data only. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Default playback quality
patches_modified.description: Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose, instead of the one Instagram picks as it plays. Nothing changes until you pick a quality. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Don't report Blend visits
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from telling a chat that you opened its Blend. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Don't report screenshots
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from telling people when you take a screenshot of their disappearing photo or video. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Don't save recent searches
patches_modified.description: Keeps the accounts and tags you open from search out of your Recent list. Searches already in Recent stay until you clear them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Explore.

patches_modified.name: Don't send reel watch history
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from learning which reels you watched and how far you got. Reels you've already watched may come back. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Download any reel
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to the menu of every reel and saves it without Instagram's watermark. You choose the quality, and best is the default. A separate Download cover switch also saves the reel's cover picture, the largest one the post carries, and Download audio saves just its sound. Download as video on a carousel with music saves every page, in order. A separate switch under Downloads puts a download icon under Save beside each reel, and others add a Lens icon for copying a reel's text, a speed icon and a Full screen icon. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Download any story
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to the menu of anyone's story. Videos save at the quality you choose and photos at their largest size, and Download as photo saves a still from a video story. A Download button at the top of a story is a separate switch, off to start, and so is a Copy text button that opens Google Lens on the story. Turn them on or off in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Download any video
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to video posts in your feed, saving the video without Instagram's watermark. Other switches add Download for photos, Download cover, a Details row with the post's time and poster, a download icon beside Save under each post, and Hold to download, which saves a post or reel you hold two fingers on. Download all waits its turn, with up to ten posts queued, so two posts' pages never mix in your gallery. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Download voice messages
patches_modified.description: Adds Save to the menu you get when you hold a voice message in a chat. It saves the recording as an audio file. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Emoji style
patches_modified.description: Shows every emoji in Google's style instead of your phone's own, or in a free emoji pack (Twemoji, OpenMoji, Blobmoji) or a color emoji font file you pick. The full change shows after you restart Instagram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_modified.name: Explore without personalization
patches_modified.description: Opens Explore on the grid that isn't personalized every time and keeps it from switching back after ten minutes. Instagram only promises that grid in the EU. A second switch hides the EU menu button for it. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Explore.

patches_modified.name: Find the reel you came from
patches_modified.description: Open a creator's profile from a reel, then their Reels tab, and it scrolls to that reel and outlines it for a moment. A photo reel is found in their posts. Stop looking ends the search, and Wait for a tap to find it holds it until you tap Find the reel. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Font
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick the font Instagram's text uses: Instagram's own, your phone's, or a .ttf or .otf file. Restart Instagram to see a change. Starts on Instagram's font. Pick one in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_modified.name: Full resolution photos
patches_modified.description: Loads photos in the largest size Instagram sends instead of one picked for your screen. A second switch asks for a larger size on screens under 1440 pixels wide, and a third gets reel covers and grid pictures at full size. Uses more data. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Full screen Reels and Home
patches_modified.description: Hides the status bar and the navigation bar while Reels shows, and optionally while Home or your messages do. Swipe in from the edge to bring them back for a moment. Back and the keyboard work as usual. It can also show stories over the whole screen on tall phones. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels (Full screen Reels), Feed (Full screen Home), Messages (Full screen Messages) and Stories (Stories fill the screen).

patches_modified.name: Glass in chats
patches_modified.description: Gives a chat's top bar frosted glass that blurs the messages under it (Android 12 and newer) and puts the back, call and video buttons on round glass circles. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Glass tab bar
patches_modified.description: Draws the tab bar as a floating, rounded pill of frosted glass that blurs what's behind it (Android 12 and newer), with a highlight on the tab you're on. Content can optionally run down behind it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Tab bar, then restart Instagram.

patches_modified.name: Group Instagram's notifications
patches_modified.description: Puts Instagram's notifications in one group, or in a group for each type, so they don't fill your notification shade. Tapping one still opens it. You can also mute the types you pick, like promo pushes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Hide AI-labeled reels
patches_modified.description: Leaves out reels that carry Instagram's own AI label. A reel without that label stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Hide Follow on feed posts
patches_modified.description: Takes the Follow and Subscribe buttons off the top of posts in your feed. The name, time and menu stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide Follow on stories
patches_modified.description: Takes the Follow button off the top of stories from accounts you don't follow. The name, time and menu stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Hide Instants
patches_modified.description: Takes the stack of Instants out of your messages. Instants is Instagram's no-edit camera for sharing quick photos with friends. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta AI
patches_modified.description: Removes Meta AI from Instagram's search bars, messages, home top bar, reels menus, share sheet and feed. Each part has its own switch. The search one and the Meta AI posts one start on, the rest start off. Change them in HushGram settings > Meta AI.

patches_modified.name: Hide Notes on profile pictures
patches_modified.description: Takes the Notes bubble off profile pictures, yours included. Notes in Messages stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_modified.name: Hide Reels in the feed
patches_modified.description: Removes the rows of suggested reels from your home feed. A reel posted by someone you follow stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Hide activity bubbles
patches_modified.description: Takes the little round pictures off posts and reels that show a friend liked, commented on or reshared them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Hides sponsored posts, reels, stories and the ad in comments, and leaves no gap where an ad would have been. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide captions
patches_modified.description: Takes the caption off posts in your feed and off reels. The post stays, and the comments sheet still shows it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide comments
patches_modified.description: Takes the Comment button and the comment count off posts in your feed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide group buttons on the share sheet
patches_modified.description: Takes the New group button and the button that sends to several people as a group off the share sheet, and lets you pick which of the round buttons under the people it shows. You can still start a group from your messages. Both start off. Find them in HushGram settings > Sharing.

patches_modified.name: Hide highlights
patches_modified.description: Takes the row of story highlights off profiles, yours and other people's. Bios, counts and posts stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_modified.name: Hide paid partnership Reels
patches_modified.description: Leaves out reels with a Paid partnership label, and reels Instagram marks as boosted. Ads have their own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Hide profile tabs
patches_modified.description: Lets you take the Reels, Reposts and Tagged tabs off profiles, yours and other people's, and keep the grid. Starts with every tab showing. Pick which to hide in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_modified.name: Hide reels by caption words
patches_modified.description: Leaves out reels whose caption holds a word or phrase from your list, or is in a language you don't keep, and Home's posts too with Also on Home. Starts off. Turn it on and type the words or languages in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Leaves out reels whose caption holds a word or phrase from your list, and Home's posts too with Also on Home. Starts off. Turn it on and type the words in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Hide reels with few views
patches_modified.description: Leaves out reels in the Reels tab with fewer views or likes than numbers you pick. Accounts you follow stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Hide rows in Instagram's settings
patches_modified.description: Lets you take the rows you don't use off Instagram's own Settings and activity screen. Open that screen once, then untick rows in HushGram settings > Layout > Rows in Instagram's settings. Every row shows to start.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested accounts in DMs
patches_modified.description: Takes the Accounts to follow section off the bottom of your messages. Your chats and follow requests stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested accounts in Reels
patches_modified.description: Leaves out the cards of accounts to follow that Instagram puts between reels. Every reel still plays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested people on profiles
patches_modified.description: Takes Suggested for you and the Discover people button off profiles. Bios, counts and posts stay. More switches take Suggested for you off the follow lists, their Suggested tab and the Follow requests screen, the Complete your profile cards off your own profile, and People you don't follow back, suggested threads and people, and the Featured section off your notifications. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested posts
patches_modified.description: Removes posts from accounts you don't follow, suggested accounts, surveys and shopping rows from Home. It also takes shop tiles out of Explore and the shopping bag off posts with tagged products. Posts from accounts you follow stay. Extra switches can also hide the 'Are you interested in this post?' question on Home and Reels, the caught up card, all videos, photos, carousels, posts you've liked or posts from accounts you pick. A post's menu has Hide posts from this account to add one to that list, and those posts leave Home on the next refresh. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested stories
patches_modified.description: Removes stories from accounts you don't follow from the row at the top of Home. More switches hide rewinds and memories, keep only verified or unverified accounts, or hide the whole row. Starts on. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Hide that you're typing
patches_modified.description: Stops the people you're chatting with from seeing when you're typing. You still see when they type. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Explore grid
patches_modified.description: Empties the grid of posts and reels on the Search tab. Search, recent searches and results stay. A second switch hides the suggested accounts that show when you tap the search bar. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Explore.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Reels tab
patches_modified.description: Takes the Reels tab off the tab bar. Reels in your feed and reels people send you still open. A second switch, Show the Reels tab, puts it back after Home when Instagram built your bar without one, and Hide wins if both are on. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels. Under Tab bar, switches do the same for Home, Search, Create, Messages and Profile, two put Messages or Activity on the bar when Instagram left them off, switches take the Create and notifications buttons off Home's header, others add a Search, Messages, Ghost mode or menu button to it or put Instagram's logo in its middle, two center the name at the top of profiles and the title on other screens, a list puts the tabs in your order, and another picks the tab Instagram opens on.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Repost button
patches_modified.description: Takes the Repost button and its count off posts and reels, so nothing gets reposted by mistake. Share still works. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Sharing.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Share button
patches_modified.description: Takes the Share button and its count off posts in your feed and off reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Sharing.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Threads button
patches_modified.description: Takes the Threads button off the top of profiles, with switches for the Create button and Share profile on your own, and Subscribe and the arrow after the buttons on creators' profiles. The menu and the other buttons stay. Each starts off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_modified.name: Hide the audio icon on posts
patches_modified.description: Takes the speaker icon off videos in your feed. Tapping the video still turns the sound on or off. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide the comment emoji row
patches_modified.description: Takes the row of quick emoji off above the comment box. The box itself stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide the home feed
patches_modified.description: Empties your home feed on purpose, so Home shows only the stories row. Profiles, Explore and Reels still show posts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide the notes row
patches_modified.description: Takes the row of notes, and the Map bubble in it, off the top of your messages. Your chats stay. A second switch takes only the Map bubble. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Hide the reply box on stories
patches_modified.description: Takes the Send message box off the bottom of other people's stories. The like and share buttons next to it stay where they are. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Hide the search bar in Messages
patches_modified.description: Takes the search bar and its Filter button off the top of your messages, the Meta AI bar too. Your chats and notes stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Hide your active status
patches_modified.description: Stops people from seeing Active now for you while you use Instagram. You still see when they're active. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Home header text
patches_modified.description: Puts words of your own, or a picture, at the top of Home in place of Instagram's logo. Nothing changes until you set one in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_modified.name: HushGram launch screen
patches_modified.description: Shows HushGram's logo instead of Instagram's on the screen you see while Instagram starts, on Android 13 and newer. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_modified.name: HushGram settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushGram settings page to Instagram. Open it by long-pressing the Instagram logo at the top of your feed or Instagram's icon, or from the top of Settings and activity. Turn features on or off there, pause HushGram and save diagnostics. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Install next to Instagram
patches_modified.description: Installs this build as a second Instagram beside your normal one, with its own data and sign-in. Pick its package name and app name in the patch's options, and whether its icon gets a HushGram badge. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Keep Home's top bar
patches_modified.description: Keeps the Instagram logo and the buttons beside it at the top of Home while you scroll. A second switch shows your feed blurred under them. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Keep Reels auto scroll on
patches_modified.description: Keeps Instagram's auto scroll in Reels turned on after you leave Reels or restart Instagram, until you turn it off yourself. It can also move on to the next reel when one ends on accounts where Instagram doesn't offer auto scroll. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Keep a seek bar on Reels
patches_modified.description: Keeps a seek bar under every reel, short ones too, with the time played and the reel's length above it, like 0:10 / 0:55. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Keep in chat
patches_modified.description: Keeps view once and replayable photos and videos in your chats after you open them, so they don't disappear. A photo or video you send stays Instagram's own sent bubble. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Keep stories playing while zooming
patches_modified.description: Keeps a story playing while you pinch to zoom it, instead of pausing it. A story you hold still first stays paused. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Keep the Reels top bar
