patches_modified.description: Stops Kick from asking you to rate the app. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Interface. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Hide subscription upsells
patches_modified.description: Hides channel Subscribe and Gift a Sub buttons and the leaderboard gift-subscription prompt. Keeps the existing subscribed indicator. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Lurk icon
patches_modified.description: Replaces Kick's launcher icon with Lurk artwork, including Android's themed icon.

patches_modified.name: Lurk in account menu
patches_modified.description: Adds a Lurk row to Kick's account menu (tap your profile picture while signed in), which opens Lurk settings. Pause Lurk leaves it on. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Advanced. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Mute stitched live ads
patches_modified.description: Experimental: ads could not be observed signed out. While Kick's player reports an ad break stitched into a live stream, mutes the player and covers the video with black and a small "Ad break", then restores both when the break's time is up, it ends, or another stream loads. The ad still plays for its full length and can't be skipped; this only silences and hides it. It acts on the ad signals Kick's player can get: an ad cue or ad break from Amazon IVS, or an ad of a MediaTailor session, which Kick only starts with Disable analytics off. None arrived in signed-out sessions, so this was checked only with made-up ad signals fed to Kick's own player code. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Normal latency
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that turns off low-latency mode for live streams: a few seconds more delay, fewer rebuffers on weak connections. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Remove tracking permissions
patches_modified.description: Removes advertising ID, ad attribution and Google Play install-referrer permissions. Other identifiers and analytics require separate controls.

patches_modified.name: Seek interval
patches_modified.description: Sets how far the rewind and forward buttons skip in videos and rewound live streams: 5, 15, 20 or 30 seconds instead of 10. Starts at Kick's 10 seconds. Choose another in Lurk settings > Playback. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Show deleted messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps chat messages that moderators delete, or remove with a timeout or ban, struck through with a (Deleted), (Timed out) or (Banned) label, the way Kick's chat shows them to moderators, along with its ban, timeout and unban lines. Lurk turns this view on inside the chat page on your phone; the chat address the app sends to Kick stays as Kick builds it, so Kick's server sees no change. Large KICKs gifts in chat also get the moderators' menu, whose Delete does nothing unless you moderate the channel. Needs an Android System WebView that can run a script before the page's own (any current one). A second switch keeps the chat when a moderator clears it. Both on by default, as on Twitch. Turn them off in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Show exact counts
patches_modified.description: Shows viewer and follower counts in full, such as 306,112 followers instead of 306.1K. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Show video stats
patches_modified.description: Shows a small panel in the corner of the player with what Kick's video player reports, refreshed every second: latency to the broadcaster, bitrate and the network estimate, buffer, dropped frames, quality and codecs. The numbers come from the player on your phone; nothing is sent anywhere, and the panel never takes a tap. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Sleep timer
patches_modified.description: Pauses playback a chosen time after it last started or resumed, including background audio. Starts off. Choose a time in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Stay on channel when it hosts
patches_modified.description: When the channel you're watching hosts another one, Kick's host dialog waits for you instead of switching when its countdown ends: Watch now still switches, Cancel stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Third-party emotes
patches_modified.description: Adds optional 7TV emotes to chat, the native picker and autocomplete, with zero-width layers and live set updates. Sends the channel owner's Kick user ID to 7tv.io, asks again every 5 minutes while the chat is open, keeps a websocket to events.7tv.io open for the channel's emote sets and loads images from cdn.7tv.app, so 7TV can see which channels you watch and for how long. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED black
patches_modified.description: Turns the dark grey of Rumble's raised surfaces (the bottom bar, search fields, cards, chips and tags) pure black for OLED screens, optionally near-black so their edges still show. Rumble's dark theme already draws pages, sheets and dialogs black; dividers and buttons keep their grey. Applies after a restart. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Background audio by default
patches_modified.description: Makes Settings > Playback > Background Play default to Sound only: leaving the app keeps the sound playing instead of opening a picture-in-picture window. A choice made in Rumble's settings still wins. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Block ads
patches_modified.description: Removes video ads (before and during videos and live streams), the ads in feeds and under videos and Home's ad sections, signed in or not. The app never requests them, so it never sends the ad server your advertising ID. Boosted (paid) videos are left out of Home, related videos, search and categories, and no ad or Boosted video impressions or clicks are reported.

patches_modified.name: Block cookie notice
patches_modified.description: Stops Rumble's Ketch consent SDK from loading, so the cookie notice never appears and no consent is recorded, and ignores consent recorded earlier. AppsFlyer, Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Firebase Performance and the Facebook SDK's app events then stay off, as before anyone consents. Push notifications keep working: Airship, Rumble's push service, still starts after a restart, with only the essential purpose Rumble asks for and its own analytics off. Settings > Data Consent no longer opens.

patches_modified.name: Block update prompts
patches_modified.description: Stops the "update required" screen and the "new version available" dialog that Rumble turns on remotely, so a patched version keeps working when Rumble raises its minimum version. Update by patching a newer version. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Change app name
patches_modified.description: Changes the name shown under Rumble's launcher icon and in Android's settings.

patches_modified.name: Chat keywords
patches_modified.description: Highlights live chat messages that mention you or contain your highlight words with a tinted background, optionally with a vibration, and hides messages with blocked words or from blocked users. Mentions are on by default; the word and user lists start empty. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Chat timestamps
patches_modified.description: Shows the time each live chat message was sent in front of the sender's name. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Clean share links
patches_modified.description: Removes everything after the ? from Rumble links before they are shared, so tracking tags such as e9s (where you found the video) can't go out with them. Rumble 3.22.0 shares clean links; this keeps them clean if the server starts adding tags.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes everything after the ? from Rumble links before they are shared, so tracking tags such as e9s (where you found the video) can't go out with them. Rumble 3.21.0 shares clean links; this keeps them clean if the server starts adding tags.

patches_modified.name: Clone app
patches_modified.description: Installs Rumble under another package name, so it sits alongside the original app with its own sign-in and settings. Use "Change app name" to tell the two apart in the launcher.

patches_modified.name: Default playback speed
patches_modified.description: Starts videos at a chosen playback speed instead of 1x, until you pick another speed in the player. Live streams without rewind still play at 1x. Starts off (1x). Choose a speed in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Default startup tab
patches_modified.description: Opens Rumble on Home or My Feed every time, instead of the one you last chose. Starts off. Choose a tab in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Default video quality
patches_modified.description: Starts videos at a chosen quality, or the closest one available, instead of Rumble's Auto. A quality you pick in the player applies to that video. Starting live streams at it too, and a lower cap on mobile data, are separate settings. Starts off (Rumble's default). Choose a quality in Lurk settings > Playback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Starts videos at a chosen quality, or the closest one available, instead of Rumble's 480p. Once you pick a quality in the player, Rumble keeps using that one. Starting live streams at it too, and a lower cap on mobile data, are separate settings. Starts off (Rumble's default). Choose a quality in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Rumble's own analytics, which it sends whatever the consent setting: clicks, impressions, searches, watch progress and player state, with your user ID, username, advertising ID and AppsFlyer ID, to e.rumble.com and its debug log. Signed-in watch history may stop updating unless watch progress is kept.

patches_modified.name: Disable autoplay
patches_modified.description: Stops Rumble from playing the next video when one ends, and from playing muted previews in feeds, including the featured video on Home. Only the defaults change: Settings > Playback can turn either back on. Starts off. Turn them on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Disable tracking SDKs
patches_modified.description: Switches Firebase Analytics and Firebase Performance off for good, so recorded consent can't turn them on, and stops the Facebook SDK from initializing itself fully, logging app events or reading the advertising ID by default. Crashlytics and AppsFlyer have no such switch and still follow consent; Block cookie notice keeps them off. Changes the APK when patching, so it has no switch in Lurk settings.

patches_modified.name: Don't save searches
patches_modified.description: Stops Rumble from keeping your searches on the phone and hides the ones it kept, so they no longer show under the search box. Suggestions still come from Rumble's server as you type. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Fill screen
patches_modified.description: Zooms videos to fill the screen in landscape, cropping the edges instead of showing black bars, on phones taller than 16:9. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Hide Create tab
patches_modified.description: Removes the Create (camera and upload) button from the bottom bar. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide Home sections
patches_modified.description: Hides Home's categories, creators and playlists rows, each with its own switch, and any section whose title you list in Lurk settings, such as Live or Rumble Originals. Starts off. Turn them on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide Join and Shop buttons
patches_modified.description: Hides the Join (paid channel membership) and Shop (a creator's store) buttons next to Follow on channels and videos, each with its own switch. Starts off. Turn them on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide Premium upsells
patches_modified.description: Hides Rumble Premium promotions: the sheet that opens over videos, the Upgrade Now banner on Home and My Feed, the special offer on the account screen, the downloads pitch and Premium gifts in live chat. Premium-only videos still say so.

patches_modified.name: Hide Shorts
patches_modified.description: Removes Shorts from the bottom bar, Home, My Feed, channel pages, categories and search. Shorts links still open. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide chat clutter
patches_modified.description: Hides pinned messages, raid and gift notices and sponsor reads in live chat, each with its own switch, and optionally chat badges or the whole chat. Starts off. Turn them on in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Hide comments and related videos
patches_modified.description: Hides the comments under videos, and the related videos the video page lists, each with its own switch. Without related videos, Autoplay next video has nothing to play. Starts off. Turn them on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide premium-only videos
patches_modified.description: Leaves videos only Rumble Premium members can watch out of Home, related videos, search and categories, unless your account has access to them. Other lists, such as channel pages and My Feed, may still show them. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide tipping and Rants
patches_modified.description: Hides the Tip buttons on channels, videos and Shorts, Rants (paid live chat messages) and paying with Rumble Wallet. Rants other viewers send still show. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Keep playing during other sounds
patches_modified.description: Choose whether Rumble pauses when another app plays sound: always (Rumble's behavior), only for longer interruptions, or never. Calls still pause playback. Starts off. Choose it in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Keep screen on while paused
patches_modified.description: Keeps the screen on while a video is paused in the player, as it is during playback. When the video ends or you leave the player, the screen can turn off again. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Lurk icon
patches_modified.description: Replaces Rumble's launcher icon with the Lurk icon, including the themed icon on Android 13+.

patches_modified.name: Player gestures
patches_modified.description: In landscape, swipe up or down on the left of the video to change the brightness, on the right to change the volume. Rumble's own double-tap to skip stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Refresh stream
patches_modified.description: When a video or live stream fails, tap the error screen to reload it at the same point. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Remember playback speed
patches_modified.description: Keeps the playback speed you last picked for every video, including after Rumble restarts, instead of going back to 1x. Live streams without rewind still play at 1x. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Remove tracking permissions
patches_modified.description: Removes the advertising ID, ad measurement, install referrer and phone state permissions. On Android 13 and newer, every SDK and Rumble's own requests then get an all-zero advertising ID; on Android 12 and older, Google Play services hands out the real one regardless, unless you delete it in Android's settings.

patches_modified.name: Resume videos when signed out
patches_modified.description: Starts videos where you left off when you aren't signed in, from the positions Rumble already keeps on the phone. Signed in, Rumble's own watch progress is unchanged. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Seek interval
patches_modified.description: Sets how far the player's rewind and forward buttons skip, instead of 15 seconds. Starts off. Choose it in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Show deleted messages
patches_modified.description: Shows the text of live chat messages that moderators remove, or that Rumble hides because the sender was muted, after Rumble's "Message was removed by moderator" label. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Show exact counts
patches_modified.description: Shows view, like, comment, follower and "watching now" counts in full (12,345 instead of 12K). Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Sleep timer
patches_modified.description: Pauses playback a chosen time after it last started or resumed, including background play and picture-in-picture. Starts off. Choose a time in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium
patches_modified.description: Turns on Rumble's local premium state once you sign in (or sign out and in again): the app then treats you as a Premium member, which skips its ad requests and Premium upsells. Rumble's server still decides premium-only videos, live gates, downloads and premium comments, and may refuse them. Checked on the app's code without a Rumble account; never tried signed in.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED black
patches_modified.description: Turns the dark theme's greys black on screens drawn with Android views: the window and navigation bar, Home, Browse and channel pages, the theatre and chat, whose backgrounds are repainted after each layout. Screens Twitch draws with Compose (parts of settings, the emote picker and some sheets) and pop-up sheets keep their dark grey. Only in Twitch's dark mode. Applies after a restart. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Anonymous chat
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that reads chat as an anonymous guest, the way Twitch does when signed out, while the rest of the app stays signed in, so you aren't listed among a channel's chatters. Sending chat messages is disabled while it's on. Off by default; applies after a restart.

patches_modified.name: Auto-claim Drops
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that claims a Drop for your account as soon as Twitch's drops notification in a channel shows it as claimable, by pressing that notification's Claim button for you: the same claim request and the same "claim" analytics event a tap sends (Disable analytics blocks the event). Each drop is claimed once per app start. Needs a signed-in account and the notification, which shows while you watch a channel with Drops; drops earned elsewhere stay in your inventory. Checked against Twitch's code on Android's runtime, not yet with a real account. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Auto-claim channel points
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that claims the channel points bonus for your account as soon as its chest appears in a channel's chat, with the same request as tapping the chest. Each bonus is claimed once. Needs a signed-in account. Checked against Twitch's code and with a stand-in for the claim service, not yet with a real account. The claim leaves out the chat mode a tap sends, which Twitch only adds to its analytics event. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Avoid stitched ads
patches_modified.description: While Twitch's server stitches an ad break into a live stream, plays the stream instead from a picture-by-picture session, the kind Twitch itself shows during breaks, which gets no ads: at 360p at most, with sound, then back to the stream's own session and quality when the break is over. The player doesn't reload. The playback token for that session is requested without your account. If a break runs past 4 minutes or the stream's own playlist stops answering, the stream comes back on a new session instead; when your own token has under a minute left, that session's token is also requested without your account, and the rest of the stream plays as a signed-out viewer's (how that affects subscriber ad exemption, minutes watched and Drops is untested). When no picture-by-picture session can be had, the break plays, and Mute stitched ads still mutes and covers it. Native and React Native players; streams started while it's off are left alone, and turning it off during a break lets that break finish on picture-by-picture first. Does nothing for streams loaded through Playlist proxy.

patches_modified.name: Background audio
patches_modified.description: Keeps streams and videos playing as audio when you leave the app, using Twitch's own "Continue Playing Audio in the Background" with its audio-only stream and media notification. Changes only the default, Never in Twitch: a choice made in Twitch's settings still wins.

patches_modified.name: Block client ads
patches_modified.description: Declines ads handled by Twitch's native client ad eligibility check using its existing not eligible result. Does not remove ads stitched into streams by the server or guarantee ad-free playback.

patches_modified.name: Block cookie notice
patches_modified.description: Hides Twitch's automatic cookie consent notice without accepting it or changing saved vendor consent. Manual consent settings stay available. Use Disable analytics to block tracking.

patches_modified.name: Block display ads
patches_modified.description: Blocks the ad requests that Block client ads doesn't cover: stream display ads (squeezeback and lower third), audio ads, multi-format ad pods, the Following headliner, feed display and video ads and brand surveys, in both the native and React Native parts of the app. Each request gets the failure or no-ad answer Twitch already handles. Sponsorship and paid-promotion labels are kept. Ads stitched into the stream by the server still play.

patches_modified.name: Change app name
patches_modified.description: Changes the name shown under Twitch's launcher icon and in Android's settings.

patches_modified.name: Chat appearance
patches_modified.description: Adds chat look settings: text, emote and badge size, message spacing, alternating row backgrounds, plain /me messages, and the width and background opacity of the landscape chat panel. Each keeps Twitch's look until changed in Lurk settings. Native live chat, chat history and VOD chat replay; React Native chat gets the text size, row backgrounds, /me style and landscape panel only.

patches_modified.name: Chat keywords
patches_modified.description: Highlights chat messages that mention you or contain your highlight words with a tinted background, optionally with a vibration, and hides messages with blocked words or from blocked users. Mentions are on by default; the word and user lists start empty and are set in Lurk settings. Native and React Native live chat and history, plus native VOD chat replay.

patches_modified.name: Chat overlay
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that scrolls live chat messages right to left across the top of the video in landscape (danmaku), as plain white text with the sender's name. Off until turned on in Lurk settings, with choices for speed and number of lines. Native live channels only: not React Native chat, VODs or chat replay. The overlay never takes touches.

patches_modified.name: Chat timestamps
patches_modified.description: Shows the time each live chat message was sent in front of it, the way Twitch already shows it on chat history, in 24-hour or 12-hour format. Whispers are unchanged.

patches_modified.name: Clean share links
patches_modified.description: Removes known Twitch attribution and campaign parameters from shared links and copied share text. Keeps timestamps, clip IDs, unknown parameters and fragments. Covers native and React Native sharing.

patches_modified.name: Clip download
patches_modified.description: Adds "Download clip" to the menu (⋮) of a clip in Twitch's clips feed, where clip links open. It asks gql.twitch.tv for the clip's video addresses and signed access token with the app's Client-ID only (no account), and Android's download manager saves the best quality as an MP4 in Downloads/Twitch. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Clone app
patches_modified.description: Installs Twitch under another package name alongside the original, with separate sign-in and settings. Amazon sign-in and verified app links may not work after re-signing.

patches_modified.name: Compact chat
patches_modified.description: Adds switches that leave chatters' badges out of native chat lines (Twitch's and third-party ones) and show emotes as their text, so no emote images load. Native live chat, chat history and VOD chat replay; React Native chat is unchanged. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Default startup tab
patches_modified.description: Adds a choice of the screen Twitch opens on instead of Home: Browse, Following or Activity. Links and notifications still open what they point to.

patches_modified.name: Default video quality
patches_modified.description: Starts playback at the selected rendition when available, with Source as the default. Saved player choices, including Auto, take priority. Unavailable renditions use Twitch's fallback. A lower rendition for metered networks (mobile data, or Wi-Fi marked as metered) can be chosen in Lurk settings > Playback > On mobile data; it's the same as on Wi-Fi until then.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Twitch's native and React Native Spade event uploads, denies local analytics SDK consent, enables Branch's limited tracking mode, blocks Crashlytics uploads, Nielsen audience pings and Sprig surveys, and prevents Sentry initialization. Watch progress, viewing statistics and rewards may stop updating. Restart Twitch after changing this setting. Playback requests still run.

patches_modified.name: Disable autoplay
patches_modified.description: Stops the next recommended video and React Native feed clip from playing automatically, and defaults feed previews to Never. Manual Play and saved feed preview choices keep working.

patches_modified.name: Emote and badge info
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that shows a small sheet when you tap an emote or a badge in native chat, chat history or VOD chat replay: the image larger, its name, where it comes from (Twitch, 7TV, BetterTTV, FrankerFaceZ, Chatterino; channel or global; who made it, when the service's list says) and a Copy name button. Signed in, Twitch emotes keep Twitch's own emote card; usernames and long presses keep what Twitch does. Native chat only; React Native chat is unchanged. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Fill screen
patches_modified.description: Zooms streams and videos to fill the screen in landscape, the strip beside the camera cutout included, cropping their top and bottom instead of showing black bars at the sides, on phones taller than 16:9. The player's buttons and the stream's details stay clear of the cutout. Vertical videos, the player next to the chat and picture-in-picture keep their bars. Works in the native theatre and in the React Native one Twitch can use while Use native player is off. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Fix notifications
patches_modified.description: Lets the patched app register for push notifications. Firebase only accepts Twitch's original package name and signing certificate, and refuses the re-signed app, so its registration requests send the original ones, which are what unpatched Twitch sends. Registration was checked; delivering a notification needs an account and wasn't. On by default; the switch is in Lurk settings > Interface and applies after a restart.

patches_modified.name: Fix stuck start screen
patches_modified.description: Opens Twitch when its start screen is still waiting after 5 seconds. Twitch waits for Branch's link lookup before it routes, and when that never answers, it stays on a blank start screen until it's closed, unpatched Twitch included. On by default; the switch is in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Force ExoPlayer
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that plays live channels and videos with the ExoPlayer backend Twitch still ships instead of Amazon IVS. Off until turned on in Lurk settings. Clips, encrypted streams and React Native players stay on IVS. Lurk patches that hook IVS, such as Normal latency, Mute stitched ads and Show video stats, don't act on ExoPlayer.

patches_modified.name: Force landscape
patches_modified.description: Turns the screen to landscape when a live stream or video opens in Twitch's native theatre, and back to the orientation the app had when the theatre closes. Twitch's rotate button still switches to portrait. Home's feed previews don't rotate. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Hide Bits tipping
patches_modified.description: Hides chat Bits buttons, Bits purchase cards, the cheering tray and one-tap Bits controls. Keeps normal chat and Bits messages sent by other viewers.

patches_modified.name: Hide Clips
patches_modified.description: Hides the Clips discovery tab on Home and the Clips tab on native channel profiles. Shared clip links still open.

patches_modified.name: Hide Home sections
patches_modified.description: Hides Stories on Home and, each with its own switch, the Continue watching, offline channels and recommended channels sections of Following.

patches_modified.name: Hide chat highlights
patches_modified.description: Hides the Hype Train, Bits and gift leaderboards, other viewers' sub and gift messages and gift banners, pinned cheers and watch-streak pop-ups, each with its own switch. Celebrations can be hidden too. Other chat messages are unchanged.

patches_modified.name: Hide mature content warning
patches_modified.description: Skips the content warning on streams, videos and clips with mature content labels, as if you had chosen Start Watching. Age, region, guardian and account restrictions still apply. Off by default.

patches_modified.name: Hide player buttons
patches_modified.description: Hides the player's Clip, Cast and Share buttons, each with its own switch. Cast stays visible by default. Other ways to clip and share, such as the channel page, are unchanged.

patches_modified.name: Hide subscription upsells
patches_modified.description: Hides Subscribe and Gift a Sub prompts, Turbo promotions and the native Turbo signup/startup offer. Keeps the existing subscribed indicator and legitimate account entitlements.

patches_modified.name: Highlight first-time chatters
patches_modified.description: Tints a chatter's first message in a channel in native live chat, using the first-msg tag Twitch's chat server puts on it. Chat history, VOD replay and React Native chat carry no such tag. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Latency badge
patches_modified.description: Shows how far a live stream plays behind the broadcast on Twitch's native player in the theatre, read from the player itself once a second (the latency the stats panel reports). Tapping it reloads the stream through Twitch's own Retry, a new access token and playlist that start at the live edge: the native player has no seek to live. Feed previews, videos and clips show nothing. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Lurk icon
patches_modified.description: Replaces Twitch's launcher icon with Lurk artwork, including Android's themed icon.

patches_modified.name: Mute stitched ads
patches_modified.description: While an ad break that Twitch's server stitched into a stream plays, mutes the player and covers the video with black, then restores both when the stream returns. Works in the native and React Native players. The ad still plays and the break isn't shorter.

patches_modified.name: Navigation bar position
patches_modified.description: Adds a choice that moves Twitch's bottom navigation bar to the top of the screen and/or hides its labels, leaving only the icons. Twitch's own layout stays until another choice is made in Lurk settings.

patches_modified.name: Normal latency
patches_modified.description: Adds a setting that turns off the player's low-latency mode for live streams: a few seconds more delay to the broadcaster, for fewer rebuffers on a weak connection. Off until turned on in Lurk settings.

patches_modified.name: Player gestures
patches_modified.description: Sets the skip interval of the video (VOD) rewind and forward buttons and the media notification, and adds brightness (left) and volume (right) swipes on the video in landscape. Twitch's -10/+30 seconds stay until you choose another interval in Lurk settings; swipes start off.

patches_modified.name: Playlist proxy
patches_modified.description: Sends live stream playlist requests to a proxy server you set in this patch's options, for example one that returns playlists without stitched ads. The proxy sees which channel you watch and when. With {channel}, only the lowercase channel name is forwarded; the original signed query is omitted. Without {channel}, the proxy gets the full request, including your signed playback token, which identifies your account. The token is in the request's address (its query, or with {url} the whole Twitch URL), so the proxy's access logs can keep it. The proxy decides what the player plays and can add segments of its own: only use a proxy you trust. An http:// proxy gets an exception from Twitch's HTTPS-only rule for its host alone, and the request travels unencrypted. Does nothing while the proxy URL is empty; once it's set, the patch's switch starts on (Lurk settings > Playback). Videos and clips are not proxied. Avoid stitched ads leaves proxied streams alone: the proxy decides what their playlists hold.
patches_modified.previous_description: Sends live stream playlist requests to a proxy server you set in this patch's options, for example one that returns playlists without stitched ads. The proxy sees which channel you watch and when, and receives each request in full, including your signed playback token, which identifies your account. The token is in the request's address (its query, or with {url} the whole Twitch URL), so the proxy's access logs can keep it. The proxy decides what the player plays and can add segments of its own: only use a proxy you trust. An http:// proxy gets an exception from Twitch's HTTPS-only rule for its host alone, and the token then travels unencrypted. Does nothing while the proxy URL is empty; once it's set, the patch's switch starts on (Lurk settings > Playback). Videos and clips are not proxied. Avoid stitched ads leaves proxied streams alone: the proxy decides what their playlists hold.

patches_modified.name: Refresh stream
patches_modified.description: Long-press the player's settings gear, or the middle of the video, to reload a stuck stream through Twitch's own Retry: a new access token and playlist for live streams, the same position for videos. Covers Twitch's native players.

patches_modified.name: Remove tracking permissions
patches_modified.description: Removes advertising ID and Google Play install-referrer permissions. Other identifiers and analytics require separate controls.

patches_modified.name: Show deleted messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps the text of chat messages that moderators delete, or remove with a timeout or ban, struck through and dimmed instead of Twitch's "message deleted" placeholder. A second switch keeps the messages when a moderator clears the whole chat.

patches_modified.name: Show video stats
patches_modified.description: Adds the video stats button Twitch shows only to its staff to the native player: latency to the broadcaster, bitrate, buffer, dropped frames, codecs and server, and for live streams the stream's uptime, from the stream age Twitch's playlist already carries. Everything shown is local to the player.

patches_modified.name: Sleep timer
patches_modified.description: Pauses playback a chosen time after it last started or resumed, through Twitch's own pause for native, portal and React Native players, and says so in a short notice. Choose the time in Lurk settings or in the player's settings sheet (the gear), which gets a Sleep timer row under Background audio; it is off until then.
patches_modified.previous_description: Pauses playback a chosen time after it last started or resumed, through Twitch's own pause for native, portal and React Native players, and says so in a short notice. Choose the time in Lurk settings; it is off until then.

patches_modified.name: Tablet layout
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that makes Twitch treat the phone as a tablet: Home and the player rotate, the player shows chat beside the video in landscape, and a navigation rail on the left replaces the bottom bar in landscape (and in portrait too with a second switch). Off until turned on in Lurk settings; applies after a restart.

patches_modified.name: Third-party badges
patches_modified.description: Adds switches that show FrankerFaceZ, Chatterino and 7TV badges and pronouns.alejo.io pronouns next to chatters' names in native and React Native chat. Each switch is off until turned on in Lurk settings. The FrankerFaceZ and Chatterino switches download that service's public list of all badge holders (api.frankerfacez.com, api.chatterino.com) about once an hour and check it on the phone, then load each badge's image from the https address the list names (FrankerFaceZ: cdn.frankerfacez.com; Chatterino: currently fourtf.com, but any host its list gives). The 7TV switch keeps a connection to 7TV's event service (events.7tv.io) while a channel's chat is open, which tells 7TV the channel, as the 7TV emotes switch does, and nothing about you or the chatters you see; 7TV sends the badges of that channel's chatters and their images come from cdn.7tv.app. The pronouns switch sends the username of each chatter whose message you see to pronouns.alejo.io.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds switches that show FrankerFaceZ and Chatterino badges and pronouns.alejo.io pronouns next to chatters' names in native and React Native chat. Each switch is off until turned on in Lurk settings. The badge switches download that service's public list of all badge holders (api.frankerfacez.com, api.chatterino.com) about once an hour and check it on the phone, then load each badge's image from the https address the list names (FrankerFaceZ: cdn.frankerfacez.com; Chatterino: currently fourtf.com, but any host its list gives). The pronouns switch sends the username of each chatter whose message you see to pronouns.alejo.io. 7TV badges are not included.

patches_modified.name: Third-party emotes
patches_modified.description: Adds switches that show 7TV, BetterTTV and FrankerFaceZ emotes in chat, Twitch's chat history and VOD chat replay. When on, each sends the ID of the channel you watch to that service (7tv.io, api.betterttv.net, api.frankerfacez.com) for its emote lists and loads the emote images from its CDN. "Emotes in the picker" also lists them in the emote picker, one section per service, and in autocomplete after ':', from the same lists; that part was checked with Twitch's own picker and autocomplete code on Android's runtime, not in the app, which needs an account to open the picker. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Use native player
patches_modified.description: Always opens live channels in Twitch's native player, never the React Native "Ultralight" player a server experiment can switch some users to. Most Lurk playback, chat and ad patches hook the native player.

patches_modified.name: VOD chapters
patches_modified.description: Adds a Chapters button to the native video (VOD) player that lists the stream's game and category changes and jumps to one through Twitch's own seek. The list comes from Twitch's public data: one request to gql.twitch.tv per video the native player loads, feed previews included, with the app's client ID and without your account. On by default; the switch is in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Watch without signing in
patches_modified.description: Opens Twitch without an account instead of stopping at the Log In / Sign Up screen, using Twitch's own signed-out mode. Streams, videos and chat can be watched; following, chatting and other account actions still ask you to sign in. Signed-in use is unchanged.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED black
patches_modified.description: Makes Kick's dark background pure black for OLED screens, optionally with near-black cards and sheets. Starts off. Choose it in Lurk settings > Interface. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Anonymous chat
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that opens Kick's chat as a guest, the way Kick opens it when you're signed out, while the rest of the app stays signed in: the chat page gets neither your sign-in token nor your account's name and ID, so its own connection to Kick's chat isn't yours. Sending chat messages is disabled while it's on, and messages that mention you aren't highlighted. Kick can still tell that you are watching: the player's playback request (postPlayerTelemetry) and the app's own live connection still identify you. Checked signed out only; whether Kick then leaves you off a channel's chatter list needs an account to see. The switch applies after a restart. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Background audio
patches_modified.description: Keeps live streams and videos playing as audio when you leave Kick, using Kick's own audio notification. A second switch turns off the automatic picture-in-picture window. On by default, as on Twitch. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Block update prompts
patches_modified.description: Stops Kick from asking for or forcing an app update. A patched Kick can't be updated from Google Play, so update by patching a newer version. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Interface. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Bypass VOD ad sessions
patches_modified.description: Experimental: uses the original VOD URL instead of requesting a separate ad-session manifest. Does not remove ads stitched into live streams. Not selected by default; once included, its switch starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Change app name
patches_modified.description: Changes Kick's name in the launcher and Android settings.

patches_modified.name: Chat keywords
patches_modified.description: Highlights chat messages that mention you or contain your highlight words with a tinted background, optionally with a vibration, and hides messages with blocked words or from blocked users. Matching happens on your phone; nothing is sent anywhere. Mentions need a signed-in account; the word and user lists start empty. A hidden message can show for a moment before it disappears. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Chat text size
patches_modified.description: Sets the chat text size, from 12 to 24 pixels, and can pack chat messages closer together (compact chat). Kick's own chat settings have a text size for signed-in accounts; this one also works signed out and, while set, wins over Kick's. Kick's chat page draws the text, so a change to that page can stop it. Starts at Kick's size with compact chat off. Choose another in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Chat timestamps
patches_modified.description: Shows the time next to each chat message, in 24-hour (13:05) or 12-hour (1:05) format as on Twitch. Kick's own chat settings can show times for signed-in accounts; this one also works signed out and, while on, wins over Kick's. Kick's chat page draws the times, so a change to that page can stop it. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Clean share links
patches_modified.description: Removes known campaign and advertising click parameters from kick.com links in share sheets. Keeps timestamps, clip IDs, unknown parameters and fragments. Kick's current share links are already clean.

patches_modified.name: Clone app
patches_modified.description: Installs Kick under another package name alongside the original, with separate sign-in and settings. Sharing sign-in with Kick's broadcaster app may not work after re-signing.

patches_modified.name: Default startup tab
patches_modified.description: Adds a choice of the screen Kick opens on instead of Home: Browse or Following. Links and notifications still open what they point to. Starts on Home. Choose another in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Default video quality
patches_modified.description: Sets the default adaptive quality ceiling to the selected height when that rendition exists. Kick can still choose a lower quality. The player's Auto option uses this ceiling. A lower starting ceiling can be set for mobile data in Lurk settings > Playback; it's off until then. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Turns off Firebase Analytics, Insider (start-up, events and queued uploads), Datadog (its start-up, so its view, action, log and trace calls go nowhere), Mux and Datazoom player analytics, and Google PAL nonce requests. Kick's own API requests still run, including the playback request that returns the stream. A second switch, Block device fingerprinting, stops FingerprintJS Pro, which Kick uses to identify this device when you sign up, for age checks and when a signed-in session starts; it starts off because sign-up and age checks can fail while it is on. Disable analytics is on by default; turn it off in Lurk settings > Privacy and restart Kick. This does not remove video ads.

patches_modified.name: Disable autoplay
patches_modified.description: Starts Kick's feed previews switched off. Existing preferences and Kick's own autoplay switch keep working. Does not change intentionally opened streams. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Don't save searches
patches_modified.description: Stops Kick from saving what you search for on this device. Searches you saved earlier stay until you remove them. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Privacy. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Fill screen
patches_modified.description: Zooms streams and videos to fill the screen in landscape, cropping their top and bottom instead of showing black bars at the sides, on phones taller than 16:9. Vertical videos and the player next to the chat keep their bars. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Hide Clips
patches_modified.description: Hides Clips tabs in Browse, channels and categories, and the popular-clips row on channels. Shared clip links still open. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Hide Home sections
patches_modified.description: Hides the featured carousel, recommended streams and categories rows on Home, each with its own switch. Starts off. Turn them on in Lurk settings > Interface. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Hide KICKs tipping
patches_modified.description: Hides the chat gift-shop button, KICKs purchase button and leaderboard tipping prompt. Received gifts still show. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Hide chat highlights
patches_modified.description: Hides pinned messages, polls and predictions, goals, sub and gift messages, host messages, reward redemptions, event and drops banners, pinned KICKs gifts and celebration prompts, each with its own switch. Other chat messages are unchanged. The sub, gift, host and reward lines inside chat are found by the class names of Kick's chat web page, which Kick can change at any time; those switches then stop hiding the lines until Lurk is updated. Starts off. Turn them on in Lurk settings > Interface. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Hide mature-content warning
patches_modified.description: Skips Kick's "18+ Mature Content Warning" on mature streams when you're signed out, as if you had tapped "I am 18+". Signed in, Kick goes by your account's own age and this changes nothing; age checks Kick runs where the law requires them aren't touched. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Hide rating prompt
patches_modified.description: Stops Kick from asking you to rate the app. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Interface. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Hide subscription upsells
patches_modified.description: Hides channel Subscribe and Gift a Sub buttons and the leaderboard gift-subscription prompt. Keeps the existing subscribed indicator. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Lurk icon
patches_modified.description: Replaces Kick's launcher icon with Lurk artwork, including Android's themed icon.

patches_modified.name: Lurk in account menu
patches_modified.description: Adds a Lurk row to Kick's account menu (tap your profile picture while signed in), which opens Lurk settings. Pause Lurk leaves it on. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Advanced. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Mute stitched live ads
patches_modified.description: Experimental: ads could not be observed signed out. While Kick's player reports an ad break stitched into a live stream, mutes the player and covers the video with black and a small "Ad break", then restores both when the break's time is up, it ends, or another stream loads. The ad still plays for its full length and can't be skipped; this only silences and hides it. It acts on the ad signals Kick's player can get: an ad cue or ad break from Amazon IVS, or an ad of a MediaTailor session, which Kick only starts with Disable analytics off. None arrived in signed-out sessions, so this was checked only with made-up ad signals fed to Kick's own player code. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Normal latency
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that turns off low-latency mode for live streams: a few seconds more delay, fewer rebuffers on weak connections. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Remove tracking permissions
patches_modified.description: Removes advertising ID, ad attribution and Google Play install-referrer permissions. Other identifiers and analytics require separate controls.

patches_modified.name: Seek interval
patches_modified.description: Sets how far the rewind and forward buttons skip in videos and rewound live streams: 5, 15, 20 or 30 seconds instead of 10. Starts at Kick's 10 seconds. Choose another in Lurk settings > Playback. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Show deleted messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps chat messages that moderators delete, or remove with a timeout or ban, struck through with a (Deleted), (Timed out) or (Banned) label, the way Kick's chat shows them to moderators, along with its ban, timeout and unban lines. Lurk turns this view on inside the chat page on your phone; the chat address the app sends to Kick stays as Kick builds it, so Kick's server sees no change. Large KICKs gifts in chat also get the moderators' menu, whose Delete does nothing unless you moderate the channel. Needs an Android System WebView that can run a script before the page's own (any current one). A second switch keeps the chat when a moderator clears it. Both on by default, as on Twitch. Turn them off in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Show exact counts
patches_modified.description: Shows viewer and follower counts in full, such as 306,112 followers instead of 306.1K. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Show video stats
patches_modified.description: Shows a small panel in the corner of the player with what Kick's video player reports, refreshed every second: latency to the broadcaster, bitrate and the network estimate, buffer, dropped frames, quality and codecs. The numbers come from the player on your phone; nothing is sent anywhere, and the panel never takes a tap. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Sleep timer
patches_modified.description: Pauses playback a chosen time after it last started or resumed, including background audio. Starts off. Choose a time in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Stay on channel when it hosts
patches_modified.description: When the channel you're watching hosts another one, Kick's host dialog waits for you instead of switching when its countdown ends: Watch now still switches, Cancel stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: Third-party emotes
patches_modified.description: Adds optional 7TV emotes to chat, the native picker and autocomplete, with zero-width layers and live set updates. Sends the channel owner's Kick user ID to 7tv.io, asks again every 5 minutes while the chat is open, keeps a websocket to events.7tv.io open for the channel's emote sets and loads images from cdn.7tv.app, so 7TV can see which channels you watch and for how long. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED black
patches_modified.description: Turns the dark grey of Rumble's raised surfaces (the bottom bar, search fields, cards, chips and tags) pure black for OLED screens, optionally near-black so their edges still show. Rumble's dark theme already draws pages, sheets and dialogs black; dividers and buttons keep their grey. Applies after a restart. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Background audio by default
patches_modified.description: Makes Settings > Playback > Background Play default to Sound only: leaving the app keeps the sound playing instead of opening a picture-in-picture window. A choice made in Rumble's settings still wins. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Block ads
patches_modified.description: Removes video ads (before and during videos and live streams), the ads in feeds and under videos and Home's ad sections, signed in or not. The app never requests them, so it never sends the ad server your advertising ID. Boosted (paid) videos are left out of Home, related videos, search and categories, and no ad or Boosted video impressions or clicks are reported.

patches_modified.name: Block cookie notice
patches_modified.description: Stops Rumble's Ketch consent SDK from loading, so the cookie notice never appears and no consent is recorded, and ignores consent recorded earlier. AppsFlyer, Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Firebase Performance and the Facebook SDK's app events then stay off, as before anyone consents. Push notifications keep working: Airship, Rumble's push service, still starts after a restart, with only the essential purpose Rumble asks for and its own analytics off. Settings > Data Consent no longer opens.

patches_modified.name: Block update prompts
patches_modified.description: Stops the "update required" screen and the "new version available" dialog that Rumble turns on remotely, so a patched version keeps working when Rumble raises its minimum version. Update by patching a newer version. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Change app name
patches_modified.description: Changes the name shown under Rumble's launcher icon and in Android's settings.

patches_modified.name: Chat keywords
patches_modified.description: Highlights live chat messages that mention you or contain your highlight words with a tinted background, optionally with a vibration, and hides messages with blocked words or from blocked users. Mentions are on by default; the word and user lists start empty. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Chat timestamps
patches_modified.description: Shows the time each live chat message was sent in front of the sender's name. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Clean share links
patches_modified.description: Removes everything after the ? from Rumble links before they are shared, so tracking tags such as e9s (where you found the video) can't go out with them. Rumble 3.22.0 shares clean links; this keeps them clean if the server starts adding tags.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes everything after the ? from Rumble links before they are shared, so tracking tags such as e9s (where you found the video) can't go out with them. Rumble 3.21.0 shares clean links; this keeps them clean if the server starts adding tags.

patches_modified.name: Clone app
patches_modified.description: Installs Rumble under another package name, so it sits alongside the original app with its own sign-in and settings. Use "Change app name" to tell the two apart in the launcher.

patches_modified.name: Default playback speed
patches_modified.description: Starts videos at a chosen playback speed instead of 1x, until you pick another speed in the player. Live streams without rewind still play at 1x. Starts off (1x). Choose a speed in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Default startup tab
patches_modified.description: Opens Rumble on Home or My Feed every time, instead of the one you last chose. Starts off. Choose a tab in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Default video quality
patches_modified.description: Starts videos at a chosen quality, or the closest one available, instead of Rumble's Auto. A quality you pick in the player applies to that video. Starting live streams at it too, and a lower cap on mobile data, are separate settings. Starts off (Rumble's default). Choose a quality in Lurk settings > Playback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Starts videos at a chosen quality, or the closest one available, instead of Rumble's 480p. Once you pick a quality in the player, Rumble keeps using that one. Starting live streams at it too, and a lower cap on mobile data, are separate settings. Starts off (Rumble's default). Choose a quality in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Rumble's own analytics, which it sends whatever the consent setting: clicks, impressions, searches, watch progress and player state, with your user ID, username, advertising ID and AppsFlyer ID, to e.rumble.com and its debug log. Signed-in watch history may stop updating unless watch progress is kept.

patches_modified.name: Disable autoplay
patches_modified.description: Stops Rumble from playing the next video when one ends, and from playing muted previews in feeds, including the featured video on Home. Only the defaults change: Settings > Playback can turn either back on. Starts off. Turn them on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Disable tracking SDKs
patches_modified.description: Switches Firebase Analytics and Firebase Performance off for good, so recorded consent can't turn them on, and stops the Facebook SDK from initializing itself fully, logging app events or reading the advertising ID by default. Crashlytics and AppsFlyer have no such switch and still follow consent; Block cookie notice keeps them off. Changes the APK when patching, so it has no switch in Lurk settings.

patches_modified.name: Don't save searches
patches_modified.description: Stops Rumble from keeping your searches on the phone and hides the ones it kept, so they no longer show under the search box. Suggestions still come from Rumble's server as you type. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Fill screen
patches_modified.description: Zooms videos to fill the screen in landscape, cropping the edges instead of showing black bars, on phones taller than 16:9. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Hide Create tab
patches_modified.description: Removes the Create (camera and upload) button from the bottom bar. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide Home sections
patches_modified.description: Hides Home's categories, creators and playlists rows, each with its own switch, and any section whose title you list in Lurk settings, such as Live or Rumble Originals. Starts off. Turn them on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide Join and Shop buttons
patches_modified.description: Hides the Join (paid channel membership) and Shop (a creator's store) buttons next to Follow on channels and videos, each with its own switch. Starts off. Turn them on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide Premium upsells
patches_modified.description: Hides Rumble Premium promotions: the sheet that opens over videos, the Upgrade Now banner on Home and My Feed, the special offer on the account screen, the downloads pitch and Premium gifts in live chat. Premium-only videos still say so.

patches_modified.name: Hide Shorts
patches_modified.description: Removes Shorts from the bottom bar, Home, My Feed, channel pages, categories and search. Shorts links still open. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide chat clutter
patches_modified.description: Hides pinned messages, raid and gift notices and sponsor reads in live chat, each with its own switch, and optionally chat badges or the whole chat. Starts off. Turn them on in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Hide comments and related videos
patches_modified.description: Hides the comments under videos, and the related videos the video page lists, each with its own switch. Without related videos, Autoplay next video has nothing to play. Starts off. Turn them on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide premium-only videos
patches_modified.description: Leaves videos only Rumble Premium members can watch out of Home, related videos, search and categories, unless your account has access to them. Other lists, such as channel pages and My Feed, may still show them. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide tipping and Rants
patches_modified.description: Hides the Tip buttons on channels, videos and Shorts, Rants (paid live chat messages) and paying with Rumble Wallet. Rants other viewers send still show. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Keep playing during other sounds
patches_modified.description: Choose whether Rumble pauses when another app plays sound: always (Rumble's behavior), only for longer interruptions, or never. Calls still pause playback. Starts off. Choose it in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Keep screen on while paused
patches_modified.description: Keeps the screen on while a video is paused in the player, as it is during playback. When the video ends or you leave the player, the screen can turn off again. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Lurk icon
patches_modified.description: Replaces Rumble's launcher icon with the Lurk icon, including the themed icon on Android 13+.

patches_modified.name: Player gestures
patches_modified.description: In landscape, swipe up or down on the left of the video to change the brightness, on the right to change the volume. Rumble's own double-tap to skip stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Refresh stream
patches_modified.description: When a video or live stream fails, tap the error screen to reload it at the same point. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Remember playback speed
patches_modified.description: Keeps the playback speed you last picked for every video, including after Rumble restarts, instead of going back to 1x. Live streams without rewind still play at 1x. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Remove tracking permissions
patches_modified.description: Removes the advertising ID, ad measurement, install referrer and phone state permissions. On Android 13 and newer, every SDK and Rumble's own requests then get an all-zero advertising ID; on Android 12 and older, Google Play services hands out the real one regardless, unless you delete it in Android's settings.

patches_modified.name: Resume videos when signed out
patches_modified.description: Starts videos where you left off when you aren't signed in, from the positions Rumble already keeps on the phone. Signed in, Rumble's own watch progress is unchanged. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Seek interval
patches_modified.description: Sets how far the player's rewind and forward buttons skip, instead of 15 seconds. Starts off. Choose it in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Show deleted messages
patches_modified.description: Shows the text of live chat messages that moderators remove, or that Rumble hides because the sender was muted, after Rumble's "Message was removed by moderator" label. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Show exact counts
patches_modified.description: Shows view, like, comment, follower and "watching now" counts in full (12,345 instead of 12K). Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Sleep timer
patches_modified.description: Pauses playback a chosen time after it last started or resumed, including background play and picture-in-picture. Starts off. Choose a time in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium
patches_modified.description: Turns on Rumble's local premium state once you sign in (or sign out and in again): the app then treats you as a Premium member, which skips its ad requests and Premium upsells. Rumble's server still decides premium-only videos, live gates, downloads and premium comments, and may refuse them. Checked on the app's code without a Rumble account; never tried signed in.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED black
patches_modified.description: Turns the dark theme's greys black on screens drawn with Android views: the window and navigation bar, Home, Browse and channel pages, the theatre and chat, whose backgrounds are repainted after each layout. Screens Twitch draws with Compose (parts of settings, the emote picker and some sheets) and pop-up sheets keep their dark grey. Only in Twitch's dark mode. Applies after a restart. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Anonymous chat
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that reads chat as an anonymous guest, the way Twitch does when signed out, while the rest of the app stays signed in, so you aren't listed among a channel's chatters. Sending chat messages is disabled while it's on. Off by default; applies after a restart.

patches_modified.name: Auto-claim Drops
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that claims a Drop for your account as soon as Twitch's drops notification in a channel shows it as claimable, by pressing that notification's Claim button for you: the same claim request and the same "claim" analytics event a tap sends (Disable analytics blocks the event). Each drop is claimed once per app start. Needs a signed-in account and the notification, which shows while you watch a channel with Drops; drops earned elsewhere stay in your inventory. Checked against Twitch's code on Android's runtime, not yet with a real account. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Auto-claim channel points
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that claims the channel points bonus for your account as soon as its chest appears in a channel's chat, with the same request as tapping the chest. Each bonus is claimed once. Needs a signed-in account. Checked against Twitch's code and with a stand-in for the claim service, not yet with a real account. The claim leaves out the chat mode a tap sends, which Twitch only adds to its analytics event. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Avoid stitched ads
patches_modified.description: While Twitch's server stitches an ad break into a live stream, plays the stream instead from a picture-by-picture session, the kind Twitch itself shows during breaks, which gets no ads: at 360p at most, with sound, then back to the stream's own session and quality when the break is over. The player doesn't reload. The playback token for that session is requested without your account. If a break runs past 4 minutes or the stream's own playlist stops answering, the stream comes back on a new session instead; when your own token has under a minute left, that session's token is also requested without your account, and the rest of the stream plays as a signed-out viewer's (how that affects subscriber ad exemption, minutes watched and Drops is untested). When no picture-by-picture session can be had, the break plays, and Mute stitched ads still mutes and covers it. Native and React Native players; streams started while it's off are left alone, and turning it off during a break lets that break finish on picture-by-picture first. Does nothing for streams loaded through Playlist proxy.

patches_modified.name: Background audio
patches_modified.description: Keeps streams and videos playing as audio when you leave the app, using Twitch's own "Continue Playing Audio in the Background" with its audio-only stream and media notification. Changes only the default, Never in Twitch: a choice made in Twitch's settings still wins.

patches_modified.name: Block client ads
patches_modified.description: Declines ads handled by Twitch's native client ad eligibility check using its existing not eligible result. Does not remove ads stitched into streams by the server or guarantee ad-free playback.

patches_modified.name: Block cookie notice
patches_modified.description: Hides Twitch's automatic cookie consent notice without accepting it or changing saved vendor consent. Manual consent settings stay available. Use Disable analytics to block tracking.

patches_modified.name: Block display ads
patches_modified.description: Blocks the ad requests that Block client ads doesn't cover: stream display ads (squeezeback and lower third), audio ads, multi-format ad pods, the Following headliner, feed display and video ads and brand surveys, in both the native and React Native parts of the app. Each request gets the failure or no-ad answer Twitch already handles. Sponsorship and paid-promotion labels are kept. Ads stitched into the stream by the server still play.

patches_modified.name: Change app name
patches_modified.description: Changes the name shown under Twitch's launcher icon and in Android's settings.

patches_modified.name: Chat appearance
patches_modified.description: Adds chat look settings: text, emote and badge size, message spacing, alternating row backgrounds, plain /me messages, and the width and background opacity of the landscape chat panel. Each keeps Twitch's look until changed in Lurk settings. Native live chat, chat history and VOD chat replay; React Native chat gets the text size, row backgrounds, /me style and landscape panel only.

patches_modified.name: Chat keywords
patches_modified.description: Highlights chat messages that mention you or contain your highlight words with a tinted background, optionally with a vibration, and hides messages with blocked words or from blocked users. Mentions are on by default; the word and user lists start empty and are set in Lurk settings. Native and React Native live chat and history, plus native VOD chat replay.

patches_modified.name: Chat overlay
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that scrolls live chat messages right to left across the top of the video in landscape (danmaku), as plain white text with the sender's name. Off until turned on in Lurk settings, with choices for speed and number of lines. Native live channels only: not React Native chat, VODs or chat replay. The overlay never takes touches.

patches_modified.name: Chat timestamps
patches_modified.description: Shows the time each live chat message was sent in front of it, the way Twitch already shows it on chat history, in 24-hour or 12-hour format. Whispers are unchanged.

patches_modified.name: Clean share links
patches_modified.description: Removes known Twitch attribution and campaign parameters from shared links and copied share text. Keeps timestamps, clip IDs, unknown parameters and fragments. Covers native and React Native sharing.

patches_modified.name: Clip download
patches_modified.description: Adds "Download clip" to the menu (⋮) of a clip in Twitch's clips feed, where clip links open. It asks gql.twitch.tv for the clip's video addresses and signed access token with the app's Client-ID only (no account), and Android's download manager saves the best quality as an MP4 in Downloads/Twitch. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Clone app
patches_modified.description: Installs Twitch under another package name alongside the original, with separate sign-in and settings. Amazon sign-in and verified app links may not work after re-signing.

patches_modified.name: Compact chat
patches_modified.description: Adds switches that leave chatters' badges out of native chat lines (Twitch's and third-party ones) and show emotes as their text, so no emote images load. Native live chat, chat history and VOD chat replay; React Native chat is unchanged. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Default startup tab
patches_modified.description: Adds a choice of the screen Twitch opens on instead of Home: Browse, Following or Activity. Links and notifications still open what they point to.

patches_modified.name: Default video quality
patches_modified.description: Starts playback at the selected rendition when available, with Source as the default. Saved player choices, including Auto, take priority. Unavailable renditions use Twitch's fallback. A lower rendition for metered networks (mobile data, or Wi-Fi marked as metered) can be chosen in Lurk settings > Playback > On mobile data; it's the same as on Wi-Fi until then.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Twitch's native and React Native Spade event uploads, denies local analytics SDK consent, enables Branch's limited tracking mode, blocks Crashlytics uploads, Nielsen audience pings and Sprig surveys, and prevents Sentry initialization. Watch progress, viewing statistics and rewards may stop updating. Restart Twitch after changing this setting. Playback requests still run.

patches_modified.name: Disable autoplay
patches_modified.description: Stops the next recommended video and React Native feed clip from playing automatically, and defaults feed previews to Never. Manual Play and saved feed preview choices keep working.

patches_modified.name: Emote and badge info
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that shows a small sheet when you tap an emote or a badge in native chat, chat history or VOD chat replay: the image larger, its name, where it comes from (Twitch, 7TV, BetterTTV, FrankerFaceZ, Chatterino; channel or global; who made it, when the service's list says) and a Copy name button.
